question: In triangle ABC, AD is the angle bisector of angle A. If AB = 8.4 cm and AC = 5.6 cm and DC = 2.8 cm, then the length of side BC will be:
solution:
Given:

AB = 8.4 cm, and AC = 5.6 cm, DC = 2.8 cm

Concept used:

The angle bisector of a triangle divides the opposite side into two parts proportional to the other two sides of the triangle.

Calculation:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a20e54160b77bb578645a15015bc4560ae34210c0818206eefeef3460b5ba820.png] 

According to the concept,

AB/AC = BD/DC

⇒ 8.4/5.6 = BD/2.8

⇒ 8.4/2 = BD

⇒ 4.2 = BD

So, BD + DC = BC

BC = 4.2 + 2.8

⇒ 7 cm

**∴ The length of side BC will be 7 cm.**
